subject: Joint marketplace demo — AWS + SI partner coordinator
body:
From: Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, alex@cloudstream.io
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for agreeing to do a joint marketplace demo with us and CloudStream. We have a few AWS execs and the marketplace listing team who want to see the integration end-to-end. Proposed 60-minute slots (US/PST):

- Tue 17 Feb — 10:00–11:00
- Wed 18 Feb — 08:00–09:00
- Thu 19 Feb — 13:00–14:00

Can you confirm which works for your side? If none, send alternative windows and we'll try to accommodate. Also: any constraints for requiring a sandbox or temporary creds for the SI to demo?

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Nair
AWS Partner Programs — Marketplace Partnerships

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the options. Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) and Sergio (SE) to confirm internal availability. Quick notes from our side:

- Wed 18 Feb 08:00 PST is tricky due to EMEA handover for our SE.
- Tue 17 Feb 10:00 PST looks best for the product + partner manager pair.
- Thu 19 Feb 13:00 PST is OK but we'd prefer an earlier slot.

We will need a short two-tab sandbox with a sample workload and a read-only set of credentials for the SI to run through the flow. Vanessa — can you confirm sandbox availability? Sergio — do you want to lead the demo or pair with Alex?

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, alex@cloudstream.io
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Thanks — I can provision a pair of sandbox instances for Tue 17 Feb. I will attach the access instructions and a short agenda. Tentative agenda (60m):

1) 5m quick intros
2) 10m value/marketplace overview (Priya + Karthik)
3) 25m live demo (Sergio + Alex)
4) 10m integration/ops (networking, logs, SSO)
5) 10m Q&A + next steps

Attachments: redwood-marketplace-demo-agenda-v1.pdf; sandbox-access-instructions.txt

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

---
From: Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, alex@cloudstream.io, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Heads up — our lead exec just flagged a conflict on Tue 17 Feb at 10:00 PST and asked if we can shift to Thu 19 Feb 11:00–12:00 PST instead. That earlier window should let us include one additional partner PM.

If Redwood can do Thu 19 Feb 11:00 PST, we will lock it in and send a calendar invite. Otherwise, we can keep the 17th but exec attendance will be limited.

Apologies for the shuffle.
Priya

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, alex@cloudstream.io
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Thanks for the update. We can move to Thu 19 Feb 11:00–12:00 PST. Vanessa — can you shift the sandbox start to 10:30 so we have a quick pre-brief at 10:45? Sergio — please plan to demo the integration flow; Alex, please confirm you can join at 10:30 for a 15-min run-through.

I'll wait for the official calendar invite from Priya and will add Redwood's internal calendar.

Karthik

---
From: Alex Foster <alex@cloudstream.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Priya Nair <pnair@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace joint demo — proposed slots

Confirmed on our side. I can join at 10:30 for the run-through and will lead the live demo with Sergio at 11:00. I attached one slide (demo-ops-notes.txt) with a short checklist for the run-through.

Best,
Alex Foster
Principal Solutions Architect, CloudStream

[Attachments referenced in thread]
- redwood-marketplace-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda, 1 page)
- sandbox-access-instructions.txt (credentials/instructions, redacted before sending to external)
- demo-ops-notes.txt (CloudStream run-through checklist)
